_contract: Committed identity of the Phase-C1 confirmation battery. The asset itself is OUT OF TREE under artifacts/, which .gitignore excludes exactly as it does the frozen recovery_search_v2 — large data is identified by hash here, not stored in git (AGENTS.md 2.5). The builder is committed and deterministic, so the asset is reproducible from this record.

sampling_rule.order: ascending cryptographic rank, ties by ascending stable id
sampling_rule.outcome_dependence: NONE — no model output of any kind is consulted
sampling_rule.difficulty_reweighting: none. Source-native metadata (MATH level, SQuAD answerability) is retained on the items and may be reported, but does not stratify.
sampling_rule.filter: skip excluded ids and excluded normalized prompt hashes

rendering: scripts/data/battery_render.py — the same renderers, instructions and id conventions as recovery_search, asserted against the frozen artifact in tests/data/test_c1_battery.py

reproducibility.determinism: an independent rebuild into a separate directory reproduced content_sha256 and every per-set sha256 exactly; manifest_sha256 differs only because it embeds created_utc and the output path

verification.isolation: PASS - disjoint from FINAL_PROMOTION, RECOVERY_SEARCH, the recovery training corpus, STATE_EVALUATION and OPERATOR_CALIBRATION by BOTH stable id and normalized prompt content; 0 collisions of either kind against every role
verification.final_promotion: read for exclusion only; not sampled from, remains unconsumed

canonicalization.method: COPY of the already-frozen bytes. The battery was NOT rebuilt for this promotion, so the scientific identity and the selection rule are untouched.
verified_from_the_copy: every file byte-identical to the repo-local source
every set sha256 equals the frozen manifest value
content_sha256 re-derived from the copy equals a285d61f...
canonicalization.why_two_copies: aad-artifacts is the canonical scientific store a paid session reads from; the repo-local copy is the working artifact the builder and the isolation verifier operate on. Both are the same bytes and both are gitignored.
